architecture: Input H&E Patch (256x256) → VFM Encoder (UNI) → Extract Spatial Map (16x16 tokens) + Neighborhood CLS Token → Sheaf Conditioning Module (Patch-wise + Overlap-aware) → Schrödinger Bridge Generator (ResNet-based) → Output IHC Patch (256x256) → Stitching (Partition-of-Unity Gluing) → Reassembled WSI

modules.name: VFM Feature Extractor
modules.function: 使用预训练的UNI Vision Foundation Model提取H&E图像的patch tokens和class token，作为sheaf的section

modules.name: Sheaf Conditioning Module
modules.function: 构建空间条件映射，将patch tokens和邻域class token整合为sheaf-like sections，处理重叠区域的上下文一致性

modules.name: Schrödinger Bridge Generator
modules.function: 基于ResNet的生成器，接收H&E图像和sheaf条件，通过SB框架生成IHC图像

modules.name: Pixel Sheaf Loss
modules.function: 计算相邻patch间sheaf的gluing一致性，最小化sheaf-Laplacian Dirichlet能量

modules.name: Fourier Edge Loss
modules.function: 在频域惩罚生成图像与目标图像的高频幅度差异，保留组织边界和核轮廓

modules.name: DAB Intensity Loss
modules.function: 通过Beer-Lambert去卷积提取DAB通道，约束IHC染色强度分布

modules.name: Stitching Utility
modules.function: 使用紧支核函数对重叠patch进行加权融合，实现partition-of-unity gluing

modules.name: Training Loop
modules.function: 执行SheafStain的训练流程，包含SB优化、sheaf一致性约束和域特定正则化

modules.name: Inference Pipeline
modules.function: 对全切片图像进行分块推理，提取VFM特征，应用sheaf条件，生成并拼接IHC图像
